b)Non-TerminatingDecimal Numbers
Many times when converting a fraction to a decimal by division method, the division
process does not end and we do not get a remainderequal to zero. In such a case, the
obtained decimal as quotient is called the non-terminating decimal.
Non-terminating decimal numbers are those decimal numbers that have an infinite number
of digits after the decimal point.
